name: Christ the Redeemer
note: A colossal religious statue, kept here as the kind's definition asks for colossal statues.

name: Brandenburg Gate
note: Built as a gate of the customs wall in the form of a triumphal gateway; kept as a monument for its quadriga and its standing as the memorial of Germany's division and reunification. The proposed City gates & walls kind (#1812) claims it too.

name: Mount Rushmore
note: The item is the mountain that carries the sculpture of the four presidents; no separate item for the carving was found, and the National Memorial item is the park around it.

name: Gateway Arch
note: The arch itself, not the national park around it.

name: National September 11 Memorial & Museum
note: One item holds the memorial pools and the museum.

name: USS Arizona Memorial
note: One source names the Pearl Harbor National Memorial, of which this memorial over the sunken battleship is the centre a visitor goes to.

name: Monument to the Revolution
note: Also holds the remains of revolutionary leaders, but was raised and is visited as the monument to the Revolution.

name: Mitad del Mundo
note: The monument complex on the equator its sources name, around the monument to the geodesic mission (Q111087641), which carries no article of its own.

name: Cristo de la Concordia
note: A colossal religious statue, kept here as the kind's definition asks for colossal statues.

name: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
Berlin Wall Memorial
note: The memorial on Bernauer Strasse, not the East Side Gallery.

name: Monument to the Battle of the Nations
Altare della Patria (Vittoriano)
note: A building raised as a monument, with the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

name: Arch of Constantine
note: An ancient triumphal arch; the archaeology kind may hold it too.

name: Arch of Titus
note: An ancient triumphal arch on the Roman Forum; the archaeology kind may hold it too.

name: Valley of Cuelgamuros
note: The monument complex formerly called the Valley of the Fallen; one source names its cross, which is part of the same monument.

name: Scott Monument
note: The monument in Edinburgh, not the one in Glasgow.

name: Canadian National Vimy Memorial
note: The memorial, not the park around it.

name: Auschwitz-Birkenau State Museum
note: A former camp kept as the memorial and museum of its victims; the camp itself was not made to commemorate, but the place is visited as a memorial and both sources name it so.

name: Warsaw Uprising Monument
note: The monument on Krasinski Square; a second item of the same name lies about a kilometre away and is not it.

name: The Motherland Calls
note: The statue that crowns the Mamayev Kurgan memorial ensemble in Volgograd.

name: Yad Vashem
note: Memorial and museum on the same grounds.

name: Azadi Tower
note: Built as a monument (the Shahyad monument) rather than as a tower visited to climb.

name: Victoria Memorial (Kolkata)
note: A memorial building that now houses a museum; the one in Kolkata, not the one in London.

name: Monument to the People's Heroes
note: The monument in Tiananmen Square, Beijing, not the one in Shanghai.

name: Spring Temple Buddha
note: A colossal religious statue, kept here as the kind's definition asks for colossal statues.

name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial (Genbaku Dome)
note: The ruin kept unrepaired as the memorial of the atomic bombing; it stands for the visit to the Peace Memorial Park around it.

name: Nagasaki Peace Park
note: A park laid out as the memorial of the atomic bombing, holding the Peace Statue.

name: Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue
note: At Tsonjin Boldog, about 54 km east of Ulaanbaatar.

name: Choeung Ek Genocidal Center
note: The killing field kept as a memorial, with its memorial stupa; the item describes the mass grave the memorial stands on.

name: Kigali Genocide Memorial
note: Memorial, museum and the burial place of many of the victims; it is visited as the memorial.

name: Voortrekker Monument
note: The monument, not the nature reserve around it.

name: Australian War Memorial
note: Memorial and museum in Canberra, not the memorial of the same name in London.

name: Shrine of Remembrance
note: The shrine in Melbourne, not the one in Brisbane.
